channel.title: Temple Terrace City Council: water utilities
channel.description: Agenda items and documents mentioning: water, sewer, wastewater, utility, pfas, stormwater.

item.title: 2026-09-17 · Agenda item 2.A. Resolution Approving a 15% Increase in Monthly Rates for City Water, Irrigation, and Wastewater Services
item.description: Staff recommends City Council adopt a resolution authorizing a 15.0% increase in City Water, Irrigation, and Wastewater Service rates and fees, effective October 1, 2026

item.title: 2026-09-15 · Agenda item 12.C. Resolution Accepting the City of Temple Terrace Water Treatment Facilities Master Plan Prepared by CHA Consulting, Inc.
item.description: Staff recommends City Council adopt a resolution accepting the City of Temple Terrace Water Treatment Facilities Master Plan prepared by CHA Consulting, Inc.

item.title: 2026-09-15 · Agenda item 12.D. Resolution Directing the City Manager to Implement Water Treatment Plant Upgrades Including a Nanofiltration System
item.description: It is recommended that Council adopt a resolution directing the City Manager to implement Water Treatment Plant Upgrades including a Nanofiltration System.

item.title: 2026-08-17 · Agenda item 5.B. Proclamation - Florida Water Professionals Month
item.description: Staff recommends that a Proclamation be issued to recognize all City of Temple Terrace employees who have played a significant part in operating and maintaining drinking water, wastewater, and stormwater systems in Florida by celebrating Florida Water Professionals Month, which applauds their constant efforts to protect our health and environment.

item.title: 2026-08-04 · Agenda item 13.A. Scheduling Two Public Hearings to Adopt the Millage and Budget Ordinances
item.description: It is recommended that City Council schedule the public hearings and ordinance readings for the millage rate and budget in the Council Chambers at 5:05 p.m. on the following dates: September 3 - Public Hearing and First Reading (Approval), September 17 - Public Hearing and Second Reading (Adoption) and also on September 17 - Resolution(s) addressing potential rate increases to utility funds.

item.title: 2026-06-16 · Agenda item 12.A. A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF TEMPLE TERRACE, FLORIDA, APPROVING THE PURCHASE OF HYDRA-STOP EQUIPMENT AND ASSOCIATED TRAINING SERVICES IN THE AMOUNT OF $148,922.29
item.description: Staff recommends City Council adopt a resolution approving the expenditure of $148,922.29 to Pentair PLC. for the purchase of a Hydra-Stop to be paid out of Account No. 410-1922-533.46-75 utilizing funds from the Water & Sewer Utilities Fund

item.title: 2026-06-02 · Agenda item 12.A. Resolution Approving Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition "SCADA" Phase 1 Water Treatment System Modernization Project
item.description: Staff recommends City Council adopt a resolution approving the expenditure of $378,890 from sole source vendor, Badger Meter Inc, to be provided with funds from the Public Works Water and Sewer funded through the current Fiscal Year 2026 budget of the Public Works Water and Sewer Utility Account 410-1921 533.63-31. The balance is to be paid from Water and Sewer Utilities Fund Reserves for Contingency.

item.title: 2026-05-19 · Agenda item 5.A. Proclamation - National Public Works Week
item.description: Staff recommends that a Proclamation be issued to bring awareness of the importance of Public Works and Public Works professionals who are engineers, managers, and employees at all levels of government and the private sector, who are responsible for rebuilding, improving and protecting our nation's transportation, water supply, water treatment and solid waste systems, public buildings, and other structures and facilities essential for our citizens.

item.title: 2026-05-19 · Agenda item 13.A. Consultant Report - Water Treatment Facilities Master Plan
2026-05-19 · Agenda item 13.B. Funding Options for Proposed Water Plant Improvements
2026-05-05 · Agenda item 5.G. Proclamation — Water Safety Month
item.description: Staff recommends that a Proclamation be issued to bring awareness to children and families regarding the importance of water safety.

item.title: 2026-04-21 · Agenda item 12.E. Resolution Approving a Piggyback Agreement with Stantec Consulting Services for a Water and Sewer Revenue Sufficiency and Bond Feasibility Analyses
item.description: It is recommended that City Council adopt a resolution approving a piggyback agreement with Stantec Consulting Services for a not-to-exceed amount of $55,040 for a water and sewer revenue sufficiency and bond feasibility analyses.

item.title: 2026-04-07 · Agenda item 5.C. Proclamation - Water Conservation Month ​
item.description: Staff recommends that a Proclamation be issued to bring awareness to encourage residents and businesses about the importance of conserving water.

item.title: 2026-03-17 · Agenda item 11.A. Resolution Approving an Easement Agreement with Tampa Electric Company, a Florida Corporation
item.description: Staff recommends City Council adopt a resolution authorizing the City Manager to enter into an agreement with Tampa Electric Company for a perpetual easement agreement to allow Tampa Electric Company the right to enter the land in Hillsborough County, Florida, identified as parcel number T-15-28-19-54V-000000-00036.0, otherwise described as Whiteway Water Treatment Plant, 6009 Whiteway Drive, Temple Terrace Florida for the installation of an electric power line extending from the nearest existing power pole to the electronic gate access point.

item.title: 2026-03-03 · Agenda item 12.D. Resolution Approving an Expenditure of $14,140.00 with P&M Communications Contractors for the Replacement of Water Service Lines Along West River Drive
item.description: It is recommended that the City Council adopt a resolution approving the expenditure of $14,140.00 with P&M Communications Contractors Inc., to relocate service lines along West River Drive.

item.title: 2026-02-17 · Agenda item 12.D. Resolution Approving a Contract with American Construction Services Inc., for the Bonnie Brae Water Main Relocation Replacement Project Phase 1
item.description: Staff recommends the City Council adopt a resolution approving a contract with American Construction Services, Inc., for the Bonnie Brae Water Main Relocation Replacement Project Phase 1 (Bid Number 25-013) at a cost of $1,350,016.75.

item.title: 2025-11-18 · Agenda item 11.A. Resolution Approving the Purchase of Two Six Inch Portable Pumps from Tradewinds Power Corp
item.description: It is recommended that the City Council adopt a resolution authorizing the purchase of two six-inch portable pumps to help address stormwater, ponding, and flooding issues during routine operations and emergency situations such as storms and hurricanes.

item.title: 2025-11-18 · Agenda item 12.A. Resolution Approving the Expenditure of $67,387.34 to Engineered Coatings Solutions, LLC for the Fowler Avenue Manhole Sewer Pipe Lining Project.
item.description: Staff recommends City Council adopt a resolution approving the expenditure of $67,387.34 to Engineered Coatings Solutions, LLC for the Fowler Avenue Manhole Sewer Pipe Lining Project from North Riverhills Drive East to Ridgedale Road, to be paid for out of the Water and Sewer Utilities Fund.

item.title: 2025-10-21 · Agenda item 11.G. Resolution Approving the Purchase of Three 2025 Ford Interceptor Criminal Investigation Utility Vehicles
item.description: It is recommended that the City Council adopt a resolution approving the 2025 Ford Police Interceptor Utility vehicles ($43,067.25 each), including all required emergency lights, siren controllers, and other equipment necessary to outfit the vehicles.

item.title: 2025-10-21 · Agenda item 12.A. Resolution Approving the Purchase of Three 2025 Ford Interceptor Police Patrol Utility Vehicles
item.description: It is recommended that the City Council adopt a resolution approving the purchase of three (3) 2025 Ford Police Interceptor Utility vehicles ($61,966.03 each), including all required emergency lights, vinyl graphics, and other equipment necessary to mark and outfit the vehicles.
